title: Lantronix CEO to Participate in Upcoming Investor and Industry Events
body_markdown:
September 8, 2026


### Lantronix CEO to Participate in Upcoming Investor and Industry Events


*CEO Saleel Awsare to discuss NDAA-compliant unmanned systems and Edge AI at five networking and investor events in September*


**IRVINE, Calif., Sept. 8, 2026 —**[Lantronix Inc.](http://www.lantronix.com/?utm_source=newswire&utm_medium=press-release&utm_campaign=investor-conferences) (Nasdaq: LTRX), a global provider of Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks,


today announced that its CEO Saleel Awsare will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


[Piper Sandler Government & Defense Technology CEO Summit](https://www.pipersandler.com/conferences-and-events)


- Tuesday, September 8, Four Seasons Hotel, Washington, D.C.


- Executive networking sessions with CEO Saleel Awsare


[Gabelli’s “Defending Our Nation” Leadership Forum](https://gabelli.com/event/gabellis-aerospace-defense-events/)


- Wednesday, September 9, The Paley Center for Media (Bennack Theater), New York


- Panel discussions on space, unmanned systems, artificial intelligence and cyber beginning at 1:30 p.m. ET, with participation from CEO Saleel Awsare


[Gabelli’s 32nd Annual Aerospace & Defense Symposium](https://gabelli.com/event/gabellis-aerospace-defense-events/)


- Thursday, September 10, Convene, 530 Fifth Ave., New York


- Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) panel at 12:00–12:45 p.m. ET with CEO Saleel Awsare; a live


[webcast](https://gabelli.com/event/gabellis-aerospace-defense-events/) of the symposium will be available to registered institutional investors


[Lake Street’s 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference](https://www.lakestreetcapitalmarkets.com/big10-conference)


- Thursday, September 10, The Metropolitan Club, New York


- One-on-one meetings with CEO Saleel Awsare and CFO Brent Stringham


**Needham’s Defense Tech Investor Day**


- Thursday, September 17, Needham & Company offices at Carlson Towers, 701 Carlson Parkway, Minnetonka, Minnesota


- Presentation at 8:45–9:25 a.m. CT with CEO Saleel Awsare, followed by Q&A


**About Lantronix**


Lantronix


Inc. (NASDAQ: LTRX) is a global leader in Edge AI and Industrial IoT solutions that power NDAA-compliant unmanned systems, critical infrastructure and resilient enterprise networks. It delivers intelligent computing, secure


connectivity


and remote management for mission-critical applications enabling customers to


optimize


operations, enhance security and accelerate digital transformation. Its comprehensive portfolio of hardware, software and services powers applications ranging from mission-critical autonomous platforms and edge analytics for critical infrastructure to intelligent surveillance and secure network management. By bringing intelligence to the network edge,


Lantronix


helps organizations achieve efficiency,


security


and a competitive edge in today’s AI-driven world. For more information, visit the


[Lantronix website](https://www.lantronix.com/) .
